```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(ggdark)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tigris)
source('Functions.r')
```
Read in necessary Henry County GIS Data
```{r}
cities <- st_read('../../../Henry County GIS Data/Georgia Smart Communities/City_Points.shp')
regions <- st_read('../../../Henry County GIS Data/Georgia Smart Communities/Regions_Smoothed.shp') %>%
  mutate('Region Name' = paste0('Region ', RegionID))
hc_border <- counties(state = 'GA', progress_bar = FALSE) %>%
  filter(NAME == 'Henry') %>%
  select(geometry)

roads <- st_read('../../../Henry County GIS Data/Georgia Smart Communities/Roads.shp')
```

```{r}
#Start response export
survey_id <- 'SV_4UULU29RAidh96m'
qualtrics_key <- 'hRLGDdJ4Ko0UqruJbW5xhsQYWBamJtpc0h4Vlj8E'

#Pull response function
get_survey_responses <- function(surveyid, api_key){
  url <- paste0("https://iad1.qualtrics.com/API/v3/surveys/", surveyid, "/export-responses")
  
  payload <- "{\n  \"format\": \"csv\",\n  \"useLabels\": true,\n  \"breakoutSets\": false\n}"
  
  encode <- 'json'
  
  req <- POST(url,
              body = payload,
              add_headers(`X-API-TOKEN` = api_key),
              content_type("application/json"), 
              encode = encode
  )
  
  progress_id <- content(req)$result$progressId
  
  Sys.sleep(5)
  
  url <- paste0("https://iad1.qualtrics.com/API/v3/surveys/", surveyid, "/export-responses/", progress_id)
  
  req <- GET(url,
             body = payload,
             add_headers(`X-API-TOKEN` = api_key),
             content_type("application/json"), 
             encode = encode
  )
  
  file_id <- content(req)$result$fileId
  
  url <- paste0("https://iad1.qualtrics.com/API/v3/surveys/", surveyid, "/export-responses/", file_id, "/file")
  
  req <- GET(url,
             body = payload,
             add_headers(`X-API-TOKEN` = api_key),
             content_type("application/octet_stream")
  )
  
  content <- content(req)
  tf <- tempfile()
  writeBin(content, tf)
  a <- unzip(tf)
  ex <- read_csv(a)
  return(ex)
}

survey_raw <- get_survey_responses(survey_id, qualtrics_key)

#Create crosswalk between question names and IDs
question_raw <- as.vector(survey_raw[2,]) %>% 
  unlist(use.names = FALSE)
question_names <- as.vector(survey_raw[1,]) %>% 
  unlist(use.names = FALSE)
question_numbers <- names(survey_raw)

question_key <- data.frame('Question.ID' = question_numbers, 'Question.Name' = question_names) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  drop_na()
```

Clean survey data (pivot to long)
```{r}
survey_longer <- survey_raw %>%
  
  .[3:nrow(.),] %>%
  
  #Pivot by question ID
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with('Q'), names_to = 'Question.ID') %>%
  
  #Parse question and choice IDs
  
  left_join(question_key, by = 'Question.ID') %>%
  
  #Get question number
  
  select(c('ResponseId', 'Question.ID', 'Question.Name', 'value')) %>%
  rename('Respondent.ID' = 'ResponseId', 'Question.Response' = 'value')

survey_clean <- survey_longer %>%
  select(c(Respondent.ID, Question.ID, Question.Response)) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = Respondent.ID, names_from = Question.ID, values_from = Question.Response)

#Get the number of responses per question
survey_numresp <- survey_longer %>%
  filter(!is.na(Question.Response)) %>%
  count(Question.ID, name = 'Total Responses')
```

##### Visualize respondent zip codes
```{r}
#Get zipcodes
zctas <- zctas(progress_bar = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#Set epsg ID to georgia state plane
epsg_id <- 26967

#Merge zipcodes with responses
survey_zips <- survey_longer %>%
  filter(Question.ID == 'Q6') %>%
  rename('Zip Code' = 'Question.Response') %>%
  count(`Zip Code`, name = 'Num Responses') %>%
  left_join(zctas, by = c('Zip Code' = 'ZCTA5CE20')) %>%
  select(`Zip Code`,`Num Responses`, geometry) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = epsg_id)

#Map zip code data
tmap_mode('plot')
zip_map <- tm_shape(survey_zips %>% filter((`Zip Code` %in% c('Prefer not to answer', NA)) == FALSE)) +
  tm_polygons(col = 'Num Responses') +
  tm_text(text = 'Zip Code', size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8, fontface = 'bold', col = 'black', xmod = 1, ymod = 0.9) +
  tm_shape(cities) +
  tm_dots(size = 0.2) +
  tm_text(text = 'Name', size = .75, ymod = -.5)
tmap_save(zip_map, 'zip_map.jpg')
```

##### Region Data Viz

Subset region questions
```{r}
region_q <- survey_longer %>%
  
  filter((str_detect(`Question.ID`, '^Q9') | str_detect(`Question.ID`, '^Q13')) == TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Question.Response)) %>%
  
  #Where multiple regions are selected, create a unique row for each region
  mutate('Area Selection' = str_split(Question.Response,',')) %>%
  unnest('Area Selection') %>%
  
  #Parse the type of development from each question
  mutate('Type of Development' = str_match(Question.Name, '- (.+)$')[,2]) %>%
  
  select(-Question.Response) %>%
  
  #Add geometry
  left_join(regions %>% select(c(geometry, `Region Name`)), by = c('Area Selection' = 'Region Name'))

survey_region_support <- region_q %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  
  #Remove non map-based questions
  filter(!str_detect(`Question.ID`, '^Q\\d+\\.')) %>%
  count(`Question.ID`, `Type of Development`, `Area Selection`, name = 'Num Responses') %>%
  
  #Add total number of responses
  left_join(survey_numresp, by = 'Question.ID') %>%
  
  mutate('Proportion in Favor' = `Num Responses` / `Total Responses`) %>%
  mutate('Region Number' = str_extract(`Area Selection`, '\\d+')) %>%
  
  #Add geometry
  left_join(regions %>% select(c(geometry, `Region Name`)), by = c('Area Selection' = 'Region Name')) %>%
  
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
  tm_fill(col = 'Region Name', legend.show = FALSE) +
```

Build custom maps with wrapper functions
```{r}
#Start response export
survey_id <- 'SV_4UULU29RAidh96m'
qualtrics_key <- 'hRLGDdJ4Ko0UqruJbW5xhsQYWBamJtpc0h4Vlj8E'

survey <- get_survey_responses(survey_id, qualtrics_key) %>%
  clean_survey()

tod <- survey %>%
  regionalize_survey() %>%
  count(`Type of Development`) %>%
  .$`Type of Development`

for(dev in tod){
 map <- regionalize_survey(survey, type_of_development = dev) %>%
   survey_to_sf() %>%
   build_map(map_title = paste0('All Residents: ', dev))
 
 print(map)
}
```

```{r}
for(dev in tod){
 map <- regionalize_survey(survey, type_of_development = dev) %>%
   filter(`Community of Residence` == 'McDonough') %>%
   survey_to_sf() %>%
   build_map(map_title = paste0('McDonough Residents: ', dev))
 
 print(map)
}
```
